Build prompt

Rebuild this interaction 1:1: Remy AI's bedroom item carousel - swiping the bottom sheet's card sideways cycles through bedroom objects, and each swipe lights the matching item up in the isometric room above.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
A dark isometric bedroom illustration (dim blue linework) above a bottom sheet carrying one item card at a time: HARD COPY BOOK, COMFORTABLE PILLOW, HUMIDIFIER, PROPER VENTILATION, BLACKOUT CURTAINS, AIR CONDITIONER, LIGHT ALARM CLOCK, EARPLUGS, EYE MASK - each with a description, attribute chips, and an "I have it" button.

## Motion spec
Pattern: synced card carousel and scene highlight, gesture-driven.
- The card tracks the horizontal swipe 1:1, the next card peeking in from the edge.
- On release, the carousel settles to the nearest card (spring stiffness 300 damping 24) with light momentum.
- As the active card changes, the corresponding object in the room crossfades from linework to a lit solid render (350ms) while the previously lit object returns to linework; the rest of the room stays dim.
- Card content (title, copy, chips) crossfades with the swipe (200ms), never sliding with the card shell.

## Calibration
- The highlight change is tied to card position, not to snap completion - it begins as the next card passes 50%.
- Sheet height and room framing never change; only the card and the lit object move.

## Reduced motion
Cards crossfade; highlight swaps without transition.

## Don't miss
- The lit object renders in white solid against the blue linework room.
- Page position is communicated only by the cards' edges - no dots or indicators.
